# `quarto-kroki` 

Render [Kroki](https://kroki.io/) diagrams in [Quarto](https://quarto.org/) documents (HTML and PDF).


## Installing

```bash
quarto add fermarsan/quarto-kroki
```

## Usage

````markdown
---
title: "My Document"
filters:
  - quarto-kroki
---


```kroki-graphviz
digraph G { 
  Hello -> World 
}
```
````

# Examples

## GraphViz

@fig-HW-graphviz shows the "Hello World" examples using Kroki and GraphViz.

::: {#fig-HW-graphviz fig-cap="Hello World in GraphViz"}
```kroki-graphviz
digraph G { 
  Hello -> World 
}
```
:::


## Svgbob

@fig-HW-svgbob shows the "Hello World" examples using Kroki and Svgbob.

::: {#fig-HW-svgbob fig-cap="Hello World in svgbob"}
```kroki-svgbob
+---------+    +---------+
|  Hello  |--->|  World  |
+---------+    +---------+
```
:::


## Ditaa

@fig-HW-Ditta shows the "Hello World" examples using Kroki and Ditaa.

::: {#fig-HW-Ditta fig-cap="Hello World in Ditta"}
```kroki-ditaa
+---------+    +---------+
|  Hello  |--->|  World  |
+---------+    +---------+
```
:::


## BlockDiag

@fig-HW-BlockDiag shows the "Hello World" examples using Kroki and BlockDiag.

::: {#fig-HW-BlockDiag fig-cap="Hello World in BlockDiag"}
```kroki-blockdiag
blockdiag {
  Hello -> World ;
  Hello [color = "greenyellow"];
  World [color = "orange"];
}
```
:::
